name: Barry O'Brien
bio: Barry O'Brien (born 1959) is an American television writer and producer best known as the co-creator of Disney Channel Original SeriesHannah Montana. His credits include Happy Days, Perfect Strangers, Hangin' with Mr. Cooper, Judging Amy, and CSI: Miami.
